title: formCAD

catalog.name: FormCAD
catalog.summary: CAD studio: 2D drafting, parametric parts, NURBS surfaces and automation on OpenCascade.

notes_for_owner: The first formcompiler build of formCAD. The release stays a draft on the private repository. The app carries no kernel or mesher worker: it downloads them from the formai-binaries releases, so 3D and simulation wait for the first occt and mesher release there. Windows runs ./formCAD in Git Bash, as formvis does, because ci.yml already runs setup/install_backend, setup/install_frontend and setup/freeze_backend that way on windows-latest for every commit; if that path fails on its first run, set windows_shell to cmd, which runs formCAD.bat (its desktop build passes --config on from 0.17.0). signing.macos is apple like the rest of the family since formcompiler 0.16.0: signed with the Developer ID and notarized. mcp_launch is left out until the bundle carries form-app.json beside the engine launcher.
